This is an extraction and retrieval task — the user wants factual comparison of specific motorcycle brake systems across model years, plus a reasoned safety judgment. That's fundamentally a factual lookup and synthesis job, not open-ended creative work.

Avocet-235B has a slight edge on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 78.5), which is the most relevant eval dimension here. The query is also warm and friendly with no harm-adjacent content, so Lapwing's distinctive strengths (aversion to fraught content, appetite for generative/novel tasks) don't come into play — neither preference profile would favor Lapwing for a straightforward spec comparison.

The other relevant evals (Summarization) are effectively tied, and the benchmark differences are within noise. So the deciding factor is the retrieval-leaning nature of the task, which points to Avocet.
